QuestInfo.name: Childhood Promises
QuestInfo.0: Bedin, the alchemist of the Zenumist tells you that he had a childhood friend who shared his hopes and aspirations. Listen to what Bedin has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Bedin wants you to deliver his experiments to #bRussellon#k and wants you to return without doing anything if Russellon does not remember the promises made when they were kids.  You wonder if Russellon will remember the promises he made with Bedin.
QuestInfo.2: Bedin and Russellon both remember their promises from their childhood. They may have been apart for a long time but they have remained friends.

0.0: You know #bRussellon#k? How's he doing? The truth is, we are childhood friends, though we haven't talked to each other in few decades... I'm not entirely sure if we're still friends.
0.1: We both dreamed of being alchemists, but we chose different paths. I ended up with the Zenumists while he went to the Alcadnos. I've heard a bit about him from time to time.
0.2: We made a promise to have a match to see who became a better alchemist in the future. I wonder if he still remembers? #rToday#k is supposed to be the day of the match. We made the promise a long time ago, so who knows... Actually, can you check for me?

yes.0: Show #bRussellon#k the fruits of my Zenumist life alchemy research. If he doesn't remember anything, then just...don't tell me. It's better that way.

no.0: Eh...it's okay if he doesn't remember.

1.0: How'd it go? What'd Russellon say? He doesn't remember anything, right?

yes.0: ...He remembered? This is Russellon's research report? Wow, he improved a lot... but I'm still better than him, just as before.

default.0: Just come back here without saying anything if #bRussellon#k doesn't remember.
